report.clinical_summary: Patient presents with fatigue (coming and going for a few months), lymphadenopathy (two small lymph nodes in neck, noticed about a month ago), unexplained weight loss (started about a month ago), and intermittent night sweats. Recently diagnosed with high blood pressure about two months ago and started taking Amlodipine as instructed. Reports taking medication as prescribed. Family history of breast cancer (mother, 15 years ago). No recent infections, travel, or close contact with sick individuals. No other significant medical conditions. Adherence to blood pressure medication confirmed.
